data.summary:
**When:** [Your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), after one of your **THOUSAND SONS PSYKER** units [Falls Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back).

**Target:** That same **THOUSAND SONS PSYKER** unit.

**Effect:** Having Fallen Back does not stop the unit from doing one of these for the rest of the turn: shooting, or declaring a charge. If it is wholly within the [Flow of Magic](vsdata:ability/thousand-sons.hexwarp-thrallband.flow-of-magic) of your army as it is targeted, it can instead do both for the rest of the turn.
